tuesday_updates.text: tuesday updates: Finalize quarterly budget. Review vendor contract before signing. Finish security compliance training module.

wednesday_updates.text: wednesday updates: Finance wants cost-cutting recommendations—brainstorm ideas. Project deadline approaching—check in with Dev team. Caught a mistake in last month’s sales data.

tech_tasks.text: tech tasks: Annual physical next month—schedule bloodwork. Dentist appointment overdue—call for an opening. Look into getting an eye exam—been straining a lot at screens lately.

workout_goals.text: workout goals: Gym at least 3x this week. Focus on strength training—legs and back need work. Try to hit 10,000 steps daily. Stretch before bed—hamstrings too tight.

diet_plan.text: diet plan: Cut back on sugar—too much soda lately. Meal prep on Sunday—grilled chicken, quinoa, and veggies. Hydration—aim for at least 3L of water per day. Protein shake after workouts.

mental_health_goals_7.text: mental health goals 7: Try to get 7+ hours of sleep. Limit screen time before bed. Schedule a day off next month—too much back-to-back work lately. Find time for hobbies—maybe pick up guitar again.
probes: mental health goals 7 try get hours

supplements_and_meds_1000.text: supplements and meds 1000: Vitamin D3—1000 IU daily. Omega-3s—good for joints. Iron levels were low last check-up—remember to take supplements. Probiotics—help with digestion, take in the morning.
